Prior experience working with Emulator or ASIC bring up environments

Prior experience in overall architecture of software systems: Linux kernel drivers (PCIE or I2C)
Prior experience with troubleshooting or debugging skills
Prior experience with test equipment automation like IXIA or Spirent
